questions.html: Which of the following statements is not a consideration in the Khosla’s theory of seepage?

options.html: Upstream sheet pile is more effective in reducing uplift.
Downstream sheet pile is more effective in reducing piping.
The upstream and downstream piles should not go deeper than the intermediate sheet pile if provided.
The inner faces of the upstream and downstream sheetpiles help in reducing the energy of water through surface friction.

questions.html: Which of the following pairs of type of precipitation and its cause is incorrect?

options.html: Frontal precipitation: Occurs due to conflict of two air masses with different temperatures and densities.
Convective precipitation: Occurs when warm air descends rapidly, compresses and cools to form clouds.
Orographic precipitation: Occurs when moist air ascends a mountain slope, cools adiabatically, and gives rainfall on the windward side.
Cyclonic precipitation: Occurs due to lifting of air masses into a low pressure zone.

questions.solution:
(b)
Convective rainfall is due to rising warm air.
